meta.name: central-dome-left-wing-wireframe-labeled

mapPrototype2Reference.interpretation: Left wing is the smaller Aero/Engineering side around column F, west of the H6 dome core.
mapPrototype2Reference.modelScaleNote: Left wing basis matches the right wing: width 4.25m, Z-span 14.25m, divided into five 2.85m parts; the unchanged shoulder aligns to parts 2 and 3.

detailExclusionZone.reason: No windows or pilasters where the fixed shoulder attaches to wing parts 2 and 3.

meta.designIntent: Separate left wing for the Central Complex. The basic massing now matches the right wing footprint while preserving left-wing-specific window, pilaster, and roof detailing.

photoInterpretation.courtyardPhoto: Snowy plaza view of the left wing: quiet two-story classical facade, repeated tall lower windows with smaller upper openings, restrained pilaster rhythm, and a continuous low roofline subordinate to the dome.
photoInterpretation.modelResponse: Uses the same base building proportions as the right wing, with left-specific facade and roof detail retained outside the shoulder attachment zone.
